author: claude
text:
provider: extract Anthropic adapter as lernie-provider-anthropic binary

Implements the v0.1 slice of the provider-adapter contract in ARCH §4.4:
subcommands describe/complete, JSON on stdio, in-band error objects
(type:error, kind:retryable|fatal, http_status, message,
retry_after_seconds), exit-0-on-valid-output, SIGTERM handler that calls
_exit(0) (async-signal-safe). Streaming is explicitly deferred to bl-d15d;
the 'streaming' capability is not advertised by describe.

The binary is a thin wrapper; logic and tests live in
src/provider/anthropic_adapter.rs and its tests submodule, so tarpaulin
gives them 100% coverage. The existing in-process client stays as the
shared wire/serde/HTTP layer — the adapter consumes it. Error-taxonomy
translation from anthropic::Error to AdapterError handles 429 retry_after
parsing, 5xx retryable vs 4xx fatal, network retryable, parse fatal.

Harness-side discovery and invocation is out of scope; it arrives with
'lernie prompt' (bl-e048). README Providers section now shows the
adapter as shipping rather than planned.
